# claude-code-vps

> claude-code-vps (`claude-vps`) is a Bash tool that turns a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 or 26.04 server into a remote workstation for Claude Code: a sudo user, key-only SSH, ufw, KDE Plasma over RDP (xrdp), Docker, Chrome, Claude Code and claudegrid. It also keeps KDE and Claude Code config in sync between your own machine and the server through a git repository.

Install on a fresh server, as root: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/halitsever/claude-code-vps/main/install.sh | sudo bash`. RDP listens on port 53389. `claude-vps publish` captures config on your own machine, and `claude-vps sync` applies it on the server. Credentials are never captured.

## Docs

- [How to run Claude Code on a VPS](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/guide/claude-code-vps): every step by hand, without the script
- [Getting started](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/guide/getting-started): the one-command install and first login
- [What gets installed](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/guide/what-it-installs): each setup step: packages, swap, SSH hardening, ufw, Plasma, xrdp, Docker, Chrome, Claude Code, dotfiles
- [Remote desktop](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/guide/remote-desktop): connecting over RDP from any OS, directly or through an SSH tunnel
- [Run Claude Code on a remote server](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/guide/claude-code): logging in on a headless server, tmux sessions and ntfy.sh phone notifications
- [Keeping config in sync](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/guide/sync): capture, publish, sync and autosync
- [CLI](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/reference/cli): every claude-vps command and option, plus install.sh variables
- [Troubleshooting](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/reference/troubleshooting): black RDP screen, SSH lockout, claude not found and sync errors

## Blog

- [Control Claude Code from your phone](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/claude-code-on-your-phone): SSH app, tmux on the server and an ntfy push
- [Claude Code Remote Control vs running it on a server](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/claude-code-remote-control): what Remote Control needs and where an always-on server helps
- [How to install Claude Code on Linux](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/install-claude-code-linux): native installer, apt, dnf, Alpine, Arch and npm
- [Claude Code notifications](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/claude-code-notifications): the Notification hook and a phone push through ntfy.sh
- [Claude Code over SSH](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/claude-code-ssh): key-only login, tmux, port forwarding, clipboard limits
- [Send push notifications with ntfy](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/ntfy-notifications): curl, topics, priorities, limits, Docker
- [ntfy vs Gotify](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/ntfy-vs-gotify): two push servers compared
- [Install Docker on Ubuntu Server](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/install-docker-ubuntu-server): docker.io or docker-ce, the docker group and ufw
- [Install Google Chrome on Ubuntu](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/install-chrome-ubuntu-server): apt repository, .deb, ARM64 and headless mode
- [claude --dangerously-skip-permissions](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/claude-dangerously-skip-permissions): what bypass mode skips, the root error and where to use it
- [Stop Claude Code asking for permission](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/claude-code-stop-asking-permission): allow rules, acceptEdits and auto mode
- [How to update Claude Code](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/update-claude-code): claude update, npm, apt, dnf, Homebrew, channels and pinning
- [Claude Code statusline](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/claude-code-statusline): usage limits, context and git branch in the status line
- [Claude Code settings.json](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/claude-code-settings-json): the settings files, precedence and a real example
- [Resume a Claude Code session](https://projects.halit.org/claude-code-vps/blog/claude-code-resume-session): --continue, --resume, /resume and transcripts
